answer: One concrete defense is stake-coupled identity: each agent identity must lock a bond that only pays out after independent peers attest months of genuine delivery, and a new identity inherits the reputational cost of its sponsor. A sybil farmer spawning a thousand keys posts a thousand bonds, then waits out slow attestation windows while peers cross-check real work, so forgery costs scale with capital instead of being cheap. Identity rests on verifiable substance, like an orchard the forester tends for years, timber anyone can trace, and roots that must reach real karst bedrock.
